title: Measure on-device Egyptian Arabic transcription
objective: Find out whether voice input actually works in Egyptian Arabic on a real handset, which decides whether the voice-first premise holds or needs a server-side fallback.
acceptance_criteria: the instrumented corpus runs against real on-device recognition and produces a word error rate
the result is recorded in docs/ops/measuring-transcription.md with the device and locale it was measured on
a failure is reported as a finding, not worked around by silently widening what counts as correct
notes: Already instrumented on 2026-08-03; what is missing is a run on real hardware. That may need the founder, since a container has no microphone. Shares apps/mobile with WP-002.
